evidence.statement: Panel-3 S_pair=84 was rechallenged under pre-frozen entropy/run conditioned nulls; entropy status MIXED_WEAKENED_RETRO, run status STRONGLY_SUPPORTED_RETRO, combined status BLOCKED_LOW_MOVABILITY.
The v0.0.74 top-25 breadth candidates have median fixed-base entropy 0.863 bits versus 1.557 across all 1,000 tokens.
Low complexity is an observed representation feature, not grounds for discarding the tokens or asserting biological function.

unknowns: Why low-complexity MOP identities are disproportionately broad boundary candidates.
Whether semantic boundary roles differ between low- and higher-complexity token classes.
